findings.summary: Whole-band correlation >=.95 gate dropped (undisclosed); only 3 patches contribute on the native scene, so the centre gap strip and lower-right quadrant are checked only by global phase.
findings.failure_scenario: Centre strip (band x112-152, 80x300 px at 1280) replaced by noise/flat colour returns unchanged (corr .816/.910); HEAD refused. A bot entering there after ready-N inspection would not stop the segment. Pad input and guards unaffected.

findings.summary: phase<.5 returns unprovable before the absolute patch-offset check, so confident agreeing motion beyond the bound under blur is treated as quality, not movement.
findings.failure_scenario: Horizontal blur 31 + 10 px shift: patches agree at ~5 band px, phase .459 -> unprovable; refusal waits up to 1 s neutral and logs pose_quality_wait. Never passes. Contradicts docstring 'Movement refuses immediately'.

findings.summary: Zero patch redundancy on the native scene: patch (1,1) uniqueness .016 < .02 even on identical frames; tail-frame margins .029-.035.
findings.failure_scenario: Any one of the three contributing patches disturbed -> unprovable -> refusal after 1 s (safe direction; retry may refuse again).

findings.summary: Full-resolution copy of every fresh startup frame for refusal evidence precedes the submit-freshness re-check.
findings.failure_scenario: ~11 MB copy per frame during the cold forward can make a fresh frame miss submission; cannot cause stale submission.

findings.summary: verify_receipt checks only format and file hashes; this receipt alone authorizes the run. CRLF rewrite on a fresh checkout fails closed.
findings.failure_scenario: Re-verify on the sitting checkout after commit.

findings.summary: Sorted-multiset call comparison cannot see relocation; the one relocated live.close() (main except -> retain_pose_refusal:136) was checked by the reviewer and still runs before any encoding.

limits: Input safety only. The 0.944 failure frame is unidentified; no exact failed-frame pass is claimed. Focal, camera map, GPU FPS cost and learned-policy acceptance remain unknown.
